strengths.text: Sourdough is the growing corner of a shrinking market.
Bread spending is still €3.4 billion a year.
Pre-orders let you bake to demand.

weaknesses.text: 72% of artisan bakers can't find skilled staff.
People buy less bread every year.
Supermarket bread is cheaper and open later.
